modifications: Original mlx2 opt-in candidate processes two activation rows per SIMD group, loading and decoding each quantized weight block once for the pair.
Preserves the existing per-row dot-product expression order and SIMD reduction; does not copy or repack model weights.
Retains the existing kernel by default; independently keys the candidate kernel and includes selection in policy/installer receipts.
Reject combining the generic QMV installer with packed Flash AST before artifact loading; packed AST retains its separately bound projection law.

public_validation.scope: Source integration and focused synthetic CPU regressions; no model qualification or performance claim.
